@graph.name: Luxury Estate Relocation Services Index (LERSI) & West Virginia Luxury Communities
@graph.description: The destination dataset for luxury estate relocation into three gated West Virginia communities — The Greenbrier Sporting Club (White Sulphur Springs), The Resort at Glade Springs (Daniels), and The Retreat at White Rock Mountain (Caldwell) — served as long-distance destination work from The Flat Rate Movers' Winchester VA and Martinsburg WV branches. The communities are destinations beyond the published service-area footprint; the company claims no past work in them. Each community record carries its sourced operating conditions (credential gates, staffed gatehouse, HOA and architectural-review regimes, mountain terrain, new-construction delivery patterns) and approximate road distances from both branches. The LERSI index states all twenty services with the company's position on each: 12 offered, 3 coordinated, 5 market-context-only (education, never offers).

@graph.name: The Greenbrier Sporting Club
@graph.description: Private residential sporting community and equity club set within the 11,000-acre estate of The Greenbrier resort. Membership is tied to real-estate ownership; homes and homesites are spread across named neighborhoods with fairway, creekside, and mountain settings.

additionalProperty.name: destinationStatus
additionalProperty.value: Long-distance destination community for The Flat Rate Movers. Not a branch location and not part of the published service-area footprint; the company claims no past work in this community.

additionalProperty.name: accessRegime
additionalProperty.value: All entrances to the club facility and residential neighborhoods are gated; gates activate via pre-programmed proximity card or vehicle tag on a centrally monitored reader system Guests of members check out temporary proximity cards at the Sporting Club Welcome Center at the entrance of Sporting Club Drive; members can request visitor vehicle passes for family and overnight guests; after hours, entry is granted via gate call boxes to the Greenbrier Security office with credentials presented Security patrols the entire 11,000-acre estate; 20 MPH speed limit on property roads

additionalProperty.name: terrainAndAccess
additionalProperty.value: Resort estate in the Allegheny Mountains just off Interstate 64. Valley-floor resort core with neighborhoods climbing surrounding slopes and ridges (Summit Village is a mountaintop enclave); internal lanes are private, gated, and speed-limited. Large-trailer access to upper neighborhoods should be surveyed per address — steep internal grades are a planning factor, sourced from the community's own mountain/ridge neighborhood descriptions.

@graph.name: The Retreat at White Rock Mountain
@graph.description: Private, gated mountaintop community atop White Rock Mountain at roughly 3,000 ft elevation. 900+ acres, low-density by design: roughly 100+ homesites of 1–10 acres across three phases, hundreds of acres held as hardwood nature preserve, underground utilities, and a mountaintop lodge/clubhouse (Allegheny Community Lodge) with a seasonal infinity pool.

additionalProperty.name: destinationStatus
additionalProperty.value: Long-distance destination community for The Flat Rate Movers. Not a branch location and not part of the published service-area footprint; the company claims no past work in this community.

additionalProperty.name: accessRegime
additionalProperty.value: The Retreat is a gated community whose gatehouse is staffed 24/7, admitting only authorized individuals (brokerage source) Listings uniformly describe a 'gated security entrance' with paved internal roads

additionalProperty.name: terrainAndAccess
additionalProperty.value: The defining access constraint of the three communities. The community sits on top of White Rock Mountain above the Greenbrier Valley floor at Caldwell; the access road climbs from the valley to ridge-top lots at ~3,000 ft. Internal roads are paved, but grades, ridge lanes, and unfinished construction sites at new builds are the planning problem — this is the terrain case behind Henry's 'steep mountain switchbacks' note and the shuttle-truck service pattern.

@graph.name: Luxury Estate Relocation Services Index (LERSI)
@graph.description: The organizing index for luxury estate relocation: six categories, twenty services, each carrying the company's true position. Offered services are company services. Coordinated services are arranged through the engagement. Market-context services describe what these relocations involve in the market and are not company offers — LERSI 302, climate-controlled transit, is market context only and is never offered. Positions: 12 offered, 3 coordinated, 5 market-context-only.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Virtual & In-Home Valuation Surveying
hasDefinedTerm.description: Comprehensive physical or digital walkthroughs to calculate volume, weight, and specific structural requirements.

additionalProperty.name: scopeNote
additionalProperty.value: Offered in its confirmed form: the pre-move valuation survey — in-home or virtual walkthrough establishing volume, weight, access and structural requirements — that opens every engagement and produces the written flat rate.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Reconciled 2026-11-07 under the owner's research-parallels directive: the pre-move survey is the company's standard first step on every job — every job is reviewed in full (scope, distance, manpower, equipment) and priced at one flat rate (owner-confirmed guarantee terms, 2026-10-29). Surveying matches a service the company already offers; it is not a new service.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Photo Inventory & Digital Asset Cataloging
hasDefinedTerm.description: Room-by-room, high-resolution photographic logging of items with conditional tagging for tracking and insurance verification.

additionalProperty.name: scopeNote
additionalProperty.value: Offered in its confirmed form: photographic documentation of the work — the company's 3-stage photo documentation on white-glove work (arrival / unboxed / final placement) and formal receiving inspection reporting. A standalone room-by-room digital asset-cataloging product beyond the move itself is not separately confirmed.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Confirmed list: '3-stage photo documentation on white-glove work'.

hasDefinedTerm.name: HOA & Security Compliance Management
hasDefinedTerm.description: Acquisition of Certificates of Insurance (COI), coordination of gated community access windows, and adherence to neighborhood vehicle length constraints.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Confirmed list assigns COI/gate coordination to 'coordinated'. All three target communities are gated with credential-based access (see communities[].gatedSecurity), so this coordination is a genuine operating condition of serving them.

hasDefinedTerm.name: White-Glove Full-Service Packing
hasDefinedTerm.description: Complete packing of all household goods using specialized premium materials (acid-free tissue, microfoam, heavy-duty boxes).

additionalProperty.name: scopeNote
additionalProperty.value: Full packing is a confirmed company service and white-glove delivery is a first-class registered service. Material specifics in the taxonomy description are market language; published copy names materials only at the step where the estate's own record supports them.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Confirmed list: 'full/partial/fragile-only packing', 'white-glove delivery & full assembly'.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Partial Packing / Fragile-Only Packing
hasDefinedTerm.description: Targeted packing restricted strictly to delicate items like glassware, porcelain, and high-value kitchenware.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Custom On-Site Crating
hasDefinedTerm.description: Design and fabrication of bespoke wooden crates for oversized, heavy, or fragile items (chandeliers, marble tops, mirrors, taxidermy).

additionalProperty.name: scopeNote
additionalProperty.value: Custom crating is a confirmed company service (including ISPM 15 export crating work). Publish as custom crating for high-value pieces; do not claim an ISPM 15 certification — the estate claims the work, not a certification.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Electronic & AV De-installation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Careful unplugging, labeling, and specialized wrapping of home theaters, server racks, sound systems, and computer setups.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Confirmed list assigns AV/tech work to 'coordinated' (de-installation/re-installation handled with the technical trades through the engagement).

hasDefinedTerm.name: Fine Art & Antique Relocation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Specialized handling of museum-quality artwork, oil paintings, and historical furniture using custom wraps and securing techniques.

additionalProperty.name: scopeNote
additionalProperty.value: Offered as high-value item moving: antiques and museum items are confirmed company services. Museum INSTITUTIONAL terms (condition reports, courier accompaniment, net terms) remain unclaimed, per standing estate rules.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Climate-Controlled Transit
hasDefinedTerm.description: Utilization of temperature and humidity-regulated trucks for sensitive cargo like wine collections, fine instruments, and high-end apparel.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: EXPLICIT FLAG: climate-controlled transit is NOT a confirmed company capability. Documented here as market demand in these communities only. Never publish as offered, never imply a climate-controlled fleet.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Piano & Heavy Instrument Moving
hasDefinedTerm.description: Rigging, padding, and transport of grand, baby grand, or upright pianos using specialized skids and boards.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Confirmed list: 'piano/antique/museum-item moving'; heavy pieces also ride the SIR protocol where weight applies.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Heavy Safe & Vault Logistics
hasDefinedTerm.description: Heavy-duty rigging for gun safes, jewelry vaults, and subterranean security equipment.

additionalProperty.name: scopeNote
additionalProperty.value: Offered within the company's published SIR high-mass band of 1,500–3,500 lbs, including gun safes, and vault-door work as its own confirmed service. Weights outside the published band are never presented as the company's own crew capacity.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Confirmed list: 'SIR heavy 1,500–3,500 lbs incl. gun safes', 'vault doors'.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Surface Protection Shielding
hasDefinedTerm.description: Installation of protective floor runners (neoplex), banister padding, door jamb protectors, and corner guards at origin and destination.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: A branded full-home shielding package (named runner/protector systems) is not in the closed confirmed-services list supplied for this program. The company's confirmed protection is at the item and floor-analysis level (furniture protection; SIR L/360 floor-deflection work). Held at market-context-only so no shielding package is invented.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Structural Disassembly
hasDefinedTerm.description: Complete breakdown of complex items (custom multi-piece beds, executive desks, pool tables, and large-scale playground equipment).

additionalProperty.name: scopeNote
additionalProperty.value: Offered in its confirmed form: disassembly (and reassembly) of standard furniture, planned up front. Oversized specialty structures named in the taxonomy (pool tables, playground equipment) are quoted per job, not promised as a standing inclusion.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Direct Dedicated-Truck Transport
hasDefinedTerm.description: Booking an exclusive, unshared moving van ensuring a continuous chain of custody directly from point A to point B.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: A dedicated-truck product is not in the closed confirmed-services list supplied for this program. The company's confirmed transit offers for these destinations are long-distance moving and final-mile delivery; exclusivity of load is a per-job commercial term, not a standing published product. Held at market-context-only pending parent confirmation.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Shuttle Truck Services (Tough-Terrain Transfer)
hasDefinedTerm.description: Transferring cargo from a 53-foot interstate hauler into smaller 26-foot box trucks to navigate winding mountain roads or tight residential gates.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Shuttle transfer is a documented market pattern for mountain/gated destinations (and the standard van-line answer to The Retreat's mountaintop ascent and Glade Springs' ridge lanes). It is not in the closed confirmed-services list as a named company service; the company's confirmed mountain-destination mechanism is its long-distance + final-mile delivery work, quoted per job. Never publish 'shuttle service' as a standing company product from this database.

hasDefinedTerm.name: High-Value Moving Insurance / Full-Value Protection
hasDefinedTerm.description: Comprehensive transit insurance policies offering replacement value coverage for items in transit.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Insurance products and coverage terms are not in the confirmed-services list and no coverage figure, carrier, or policy term may be published without a sourced company document. Market-context-only.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Complete Structural Reassembly
hasDefinedTerm.description: Rebuilding all furniture, beds, and complex structures to their original configurations.

additionalProperty.name: scopeNote
additionalProperty.value: Offered in its confirmed form: full assembly on white-glove work and reassembly of standard furniture. 'All complex structures' is taxonomy breadth, not a company promise.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Confirmed list: 'white-glove delivery & full assembly', 'disassembly/reassembly of standard furniture'.

hasDefinedTerm.name: White-Glove Room-by-Room Unpacking
hasDefinedTerm.description: Careful unboxing and placement of items onto surfaces, counter spaces, and shelving as directed by the homeowner.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Complete Debris & Box Removal
hasDefinedTerm.description: Same-day collection and eco-friendly disposal/recycling of all empty cardboard, paper wrap, and plastic shielding from the estate.

additionalProperty.name: scopeNote
additionalProperty.value: Offered in its confirmed form: packaging/pallet removal and old-item haul-away on white-glove accounts (same-day debris removal is the white-glove pattern Henry supplied). 'Eco-friendly disposal/recycling' wording is taxonomy language — publish only the removal itself, not a recycling claim.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Confirmed list: 'debris/packaging removal on white-glove accounts'.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Third-Party Technical Re-installation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Post-move calibration and mounting of televisions, audio systems, and smart-home components.

additionalProperty.name: basis
additionalProperty.value: Confirmed list assigns AV/tech re-installation to 'coordinated' — the taxonomy itself names this one 'third-party', which matches the coordinated position exactly.
